_note: THE REGISTRY: every collection and every wing of the site, read by every page. One key per wing (the museum app's own slug), in the order the wings opened: the last open one is the newest and hangs largest. Keys that start with an underscore are not wings. state: open, making or planned. An open wing needs every key below, its two data files in wings/ and its pictures: the build stops otherwise. name, page, door, about, never_say and claim_phrase are the six keys the topic pages' build reads (pages/build.py, WINGS_FILE). note: the wing's one colour, written here because a wing is data: the build checks its lightness and chroma against the palette's bounds. wall: deep, wall or lifted. pictures: hero is the first picture of the wing's own page, card its plate on the wall of wings, share its link preview. landing is optional: another first picture for the landing's place when this wing is the newest, with its words under landing.piece in the wing's data. Without it the landing hangs hero. A first screen takes only a frame of the museum's own build in which no reproduction can be seen. counts: only for a wing without a facts file (wings/<wing>.facts.json), which otherwise holds every number. out: optional, the wing's one way to another site of the organisation ({lang} is the page's language, or English where the other site does not speak it: speaks). Its line of words is out.line in the wing's data, and both stand on the page about the museum. when: the year the wing shows, a number, negative before the year one: the menu lists the wings in the order of time. count: optional, the name of the wing's page in the museum's own count (the build writes it into ../functions/_count/lists.js); without it the wing's key. topics: the wing's topic pages (pages/<name>.<lang>.json), each with its slug, name and line per language; langs, optional, the languages it is written in (always English; a language without it links the English page), else every built language; count, optional, its name in the count, which then never changes with its address; from, optional, the group of the wing's page whose works the page shows and under whose list the wing's page links it.

line.en: Places where people from history lived and worked.
line.de: Orte, an denen Menschen aus der Geschichte lebten und arbeiteten.

film._note: What the museum's film says of this wing: line at the house in the full film, offer in the arrival cut, sky said once, held under its sky and house, inside.line what the room is that the film looks into, ground.focus the band of the card picture under the seven stars as shares [x centre, top, bottom]. The year is when.

offer.en: 1517. Leonardo’s last house, rebuilt. You can walk in.
offer.de: 1517. Leonardos letztes Haus, nachgebaut. Du kannst hineingehen.

line.en: Our own hall for his machines.
line.de: Unser eigener Saal für seine Maschinen.

line.en: What Leonardo da Vinci drew, what was ever built and what was older than he was.
line.de: Was Leonardo da Vinci zeichnete, was je gebaut wurde und was älter war als er.

line.en: Work by work: what each shows, when he painted it, where it hangs and how sure scholars are that it is his.
line.de: Werk für Werk: was jedes zeigt, wann er es malte, wo es hängt und wie sicher es ihm zugeschrieben wird.

name.en: How big is the Mona Lisa
name.de: Wie groß ist die Mona Lisa

line.en: The 24 works of the wing's picture room and the Last Supper to one scale beside a person, each with its size and its holder.
line.de: Die 24 Werke aus dem Bildersaal des Flügels und das Abendmahl im selben Maßstab neben einem Menschen, jedes mit seiner Größe und seinem Haus.

line.en: The wall in Milan, 4.6 by 8.8 metres: how he painted it, what five centuries did to it, and what is left.
line.de: Die Wand in Mailand, 4,6 mal 8,8 Meter: wie er es malte, was ihm fünf Jahrhunderte antaten und was übrig ist.

name.en: Leonardo da Vinci's death and grave
name.de: Leonardo da Vincis Tod und Grab

line.en: The church he was buried in is gone. What the chapel of Saint-Hubert holds, and how sure that is.
line.de: Seine Grabkirche wurde abgerissen. Was heute in der Kapelle Saint-Hubert liegt, und wie sicher das ist.

animals._note: A wing in the making that already has pages of its own: pages_only keeps it off the landing's wall, its film and the menu until it opens, so it needs no collection, door, dates or pictures yet. Its pages stand in its own languages only (langs), and every page of it shows a plain link to the newest open wing where a door would stand. A topic page may carry its own about and never_say: those rules hold for that page alone, the wing's for all of them.

line.en: About 16 m (52 ft) by the one long backbone ever found, the largest perhaps about 20 m. Beside a person, a great white and a blue whale.
line.de: Etwa 16 m nach der einen langen Wirbelsäule, die größten vielleicht etwa 20 m. Größenvergleich mit Mensch, Weißem Hai und Blauwal.
